line: Led research on the mobile onboarding flow, testing three prototypes with 24 new customers; the shipped design raised completed sign-ups from 41% to 58% in the quarter after launch.
defect: The entry's strongest, most quantified achievement is its last bullet instead of its first.

line: Validated the redesigned app navigation's findability with an open card sort of 30 customers before it shipped.
defect: An open card sort shows how people group content; it cannot measure whether they find items in a given navigation, which needs a tree test or task-based test.

line: Brought the design system to WCAG 2.1 AA by setting body-text contrast to at least 3:1 against every background.
defect: WCAG 2.1 AA requires a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for body text; 3:1 is enough only for large text, so the design system does not meet AA.
